tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha mo'i bstod pa bskul ba dang bcas pa bzhugs so// bhyoḥ bde chen rol pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i zhal/ /he ru ka dpal yab dang lhan cig sbyor/ /chos dbyings ngang nas dus gsum rgyal ba kun/ /skyed pa'i yum chen dbang phyug lha mor 'dud/ /khyod ni rlung nag dgu rlung 'khyil ba'i klong / /dus me'i phung po 'tshub cing 'bar ba'i khrod/ /khrag zhag rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /baṃ chen gsar rnying brtsegs pa'i khri steng na/ /mun pa'i mdangs dang 'dres pa'i rakta'i mdog /mthong bas dgra bo'i srog 'phrog srin mo'i gzugs/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri yud kyis nyul ba yi/ /dre'u rta'i steng na rngam brjid rol pas bzhugs/ /dam nyams khrag rgyun lbu ba rab mchil ba'i/ /zhal dmar gnam sa'i bar du rab gdangs shing / /ljags kyi glog 'phreng srid gsum khyab par g.yo/ /rno dkar mche ba mi bzad gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /dgra bgegs snying 'byin sgrub la bde ster ba'i/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs nga ro dang 'dres pa'i/ /bhyo bhyo rakmo kro ta'i sprin gyi sgra/ /chem chem shugs pa'i sgra chen nam mkha'i rnga/ /'jigs rung khyod zhal char sprin phung po la/ /gyen du phyogs pa'i mig yang g.yo ba can/ /mdongs ldan ma mo mkha' 'gro drag po'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i gar byed rngam pa'i bzhad sgra sgrog /dmar zhing zlum pa'i gdangs mig bgrad pa yis/ /bstan dgra'i rjes gcod rnal 'byor bya ra byed/ /'phrog byed dbang po dug can brang 'gro yis/ /g.yas g.yon rna ba'i bu ga mdzes par brgyan/ /phyag g.yas rab 'bar srin po'i ral gri ni/ /'phyar ba'i mod la bdud sde'i mgo bo rnams/ /dpyid dus sad kyis btab pa'i lo tog bzhin/ /skad cig nyid la cig car 'dzin mar 'bebs/ /dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs rdzogs ldan sprin/ /mdzes sdug ne'u le'i gzugs kyis ngom bzhin du/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis bzung ba'i mkha' dbyings nas/

/rnal 'byor bskyang phyir nor bu'i gru char 'bebs/ /thod skam kha ba'i phung pos bskor ba yi/ /dmar ser ral pa'i mtshams sprin ri bo'i spor/ /zla shel bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar shar ba'i mod/ /rnal 'byor snying gi gdung ba ma lus 'phrog /rakta 'khyil ba'i lte ba'i dbyings rum nas/ /srid gsum 'od kyis 'gengs pa'i padmo'i gnyen/ /gzi 'od 'bar bas thub bstan chu skyes tshal/ /'dzum dkar rgod cing bdud sde'i mun stug 'joms/ /khrag 'dzag mi yi rgyu ma gsar ba la/ /bcings pa'i dam nyams mgo rlon 'phreng ba ni/ /klad pa ser skya lug cing mig zum pa'i/ /khrag rgyun 'bab ba'i do shal ring du 'phyang / /mi lpags rlon pa'i stod g.yogs sprin ltar g.yo/ /re lde nag po'i sham thabs mun ltar stibs/ /dug gi kha rlangs chu mthong 'gog pa yi/ /sbrul nag gdug pa'i chun po rgyan du byas/ /sdig can yul khams 'gengs pa'i nad rkyal dang / /dam nyams rtsis 'debs bdud kyi khram shing dang / /phung byed shwa dhel mtshon gyi gru gu sogs/ /smod pa'i mtshon chas dam nyams rtsad nas gcod/ /khyod kyi g.yas na ming po gdengs gcen rje/ /sprin dkar ltar gsal phuṭa phuṭa 'brug stong ldir/ /khyod g.yon nam mkha' las mkhan klu bdud nag /ha la'i dug 'dra dam nyams yongs kyi gshed/ /dre'u rta'i sna khrid khol mo re ma ti/ /chu srin gdong can dgra yul mtshon char 'bebs/ mdun na 'brog sman ba lang drel sna ma/ /dre'u sgug cing dgra snying spar gyis 'debs/ /rgyab na sman khri sman 'dem drug ma ma/ /bya nag zhon nas khyod kyi phyi bzhin 'brang / /zla 'od ltar gsal zhal gyi pho nya mo/ /nam mkha'i mdangs can ral pa 'dzings pa mo/ /byi ru'i mdog 'dzin gtum chen rngam pa mo/ /gser mdog rdo rje mkha' la bzhad pa mo/ /kun kyang rang dang mdog mtshungs ma mo'i tshogs/ /grangs med 'khor gyis bskor nas phyogs bzhir gnas/

/sgeg cing chags la drag cing mi sdug gzugs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrub la brtson/ /ye shes ma mo'i tshogs ni sprin ltar stibs/ /las kyi ma mo'i tshogs ni glog ltar 'khyug /bod khams bstan ma'i tshogs ni rlung ltar 'tshub/ /dregs byed srin po'i tshogs ni bran ltar rgyug /thams cad dpal ldan lha mo'i bka' nyan te/ /bstan pa srung zhing rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i/ /bcol ba'i las kun bde blag sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dam can 'khor tshogs bcas la bdag bstod do/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang mo la/ /bstod pas khyod thugs dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /'bras bu 'dod pa'i char rgyun legs phab ste/ /rnal 'byor snying gi bum bzang gang bar shog /ces dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la bstod pa'i rab byed 'di yang dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtshos rgyan gong dge gnas kyi gtsug lag khang gi dpal lha mo'i sku brnyan gyi drung du thogs med sbyar nas phul ba'o// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ lha mo'i bstod pa bskul ba dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
